text.aria-label: Title text 'Day-ahead forecasts and measured net power in four calendar-rule weeks'

g.text: Day-ahead forecasts and measured net power in four calendar-rule weeks

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Net power as a percentage of each substation's effective capacity (negative is export). Black: measured. Blue line: median of B-gen with the filter. Darker band: 80% interval (q10 to q90). Lighter band: 90% interval (q05 to q95). The weeks are the first full Monday-to-Sunday week of January, April, July, and October in the scored year, chosen by a calendar rule that does not depend on any score.'
